scope: Single-host real loopback HTTP, normal registrations in two workspaces, PostgreSQL persistence, simulated upstream terminal failures.
interpretation: Window boundaries are elapsed milliseconds. The final partial window ends at the observed finish. GETWritten counts successful client WroteRequest. GETArrived and HTTP2xx are independently counted at the fixture.

SameHandleWriteInterval is between consecutive writes for one original handle. HandlerService measures actual upstream handler residency. query_dispatch_attempts includes unclaimed scheduler attempts.

Only independently sampled in-flight tasks contribute to population statistics. Frontiers use the last statement wholly inside each window. An absent frontier is null. Time-gate eligibility alone does not guarantee a claim.

A same-version snapshot before and after a write certifies its assignment. Missing brackets, unsampled versions and raw-due maturities crossing window boundaries remain uncertain. Sampled backlog maxima are lower bounds.

TerminalRows are counted by durable UpdatedAt; TerminalSeen by first independent observation. The benchmark produces known upstream failures with original receipts. Successful asset delivery requires separate evidence.
Additional acceptance requires a designated deployment, external load machine, provider quotas, 100 new tasks/s, concurrent 60,000 inflight with 6,000 original GET/s, and a 24h run.
